verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no documented user-facing control over data retention or deletion, such as retention settings, deletion APIs, or a zero-retention toggle. The only relevant item is a community quote of the privacy policy describing tier-based training and usage terms (free tier may train on code; enterprise processes only the immediate request). That is a plan-level policy, not a retention or deletion control the user can exercise.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
